title: Natural RHom comparison with the cocycle roof formula
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and let $M\in\mathcal A$. Set $v=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive], $Rv:D^+(\mathcal A)\to D^+(\mathrm{Ab})$ its total right derived functor [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], and $S=M[0]$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. There exists a family of additive isomorphisms $\psi_X^n:H^n(Rv(X))\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(S,X[n])$, for every $X\in D^+(\mathcal A)$ and $n\in\mathbf Z$, natural in $X$: $\psi_Y^n(H^n(Rv(g))(a))=g[n]\circ\psi_X^n(a)$. For every bounded below complex $K$ and every chosen quasi-isomorphism $\varepsilon:K\to I$ into a bounded below degreewise injective K-injective complex [def-sp-kinjective-bridge], and every cocycle $f:M\to I^n$, the class of $f$ in $H^n(v(I))$, transported to $H^n(Rv(QK))$ by the canonical derived unit on $I$ and $Rv(Q\varepsilon)^{-1}$, maps under $\psi_{QK}^n$ to $f$ regarded as a localized complex map $S\to QI[n]$, postcomposed with $(Q\varepsilon)[n]^{-1}$. The canonical quotient-to-derived comparison isomorphisms identify the Q images with the Plus.Q images on both sides, as in the Lean formula. No compatibility with shifts between degrees or with triangles is asserted.

proof.text: Obtain the natural additive map normalized on injective cocycles from lem-sc-p1-rhom-natural-cocycle-map. For each X choose an injective representative QI isomorphic to X using Mathlib exists_injective_nonempty_iso. The normalized map on QI is bijective by lem-sc-p1-rhom-injective-cocycle-bijective. Naturality with the representing isomorphism and its inverse transfers injectivity and surjectivity to X. Package the same maps with AddEquiv.ofBijective; their naturality is unchanged.

For the given resolution r:K→I form the representing isomorphism e using the quotient comparison and Q(r). Apply naturality to e.inv and then the injective cocycle normalization. Expand the image of e.inv under the fully faithful Plus inclusion via map_preimage; it is the inverse quotient comparison on I followed by inv(Q(r)) and the quotient comparison on K. After shifting, the adjacent quotient comparison and inverse cancel, giving exactly the required roof. This proves the formula for every specified resolution without a separate resolution-independence lemma.
